shots.note: HOOK: wide on the cold island, both wrecks in frame (one each end); push in on the Grafton hull and its 1864 board within 2 s
crane from one camp across the island ridge to the other: they can't see each other
Grafton camp: heroLow on five men raising a hut; on 'took turns cooking' a pot over a fire, a bowl handed across; 5 MEN on the hut door
a painted 40 KM signpost on the ridge, then down to the Invercauld surf: men crawl ashore, then scatter, each alone ('every man for himself')
back at the Grafton: the crew building a small boat on the beach (medium, hands working)
three men push the boat off into big grey waves; wide, the boat small against the ocean
'All five lived': the five together on the beach, close group shot
'only three survived': three figures far apart on a dark shore; slow, still framing
'Same island. Same cold. Same storms.': three beats, each a crane higher over the island, both camps in frame
PAYOFF: settle on the Grafton hut's lit window as the five share a meal; slow push, ends 0.6 s after 'other.'
